headline: Indian Rupee Strengthens to Seven-Month High of 93.47 per Dollar
summary: The Indian rupee appreciated 0.5% to close at 93.47 against the US dollar, reaching a seven-month high supported by sustained foreign equity inflows and short covering.
why: The rupee's exchange rate influences Indian import inflation, foreign portfolio allocations, and central bank foreign reserve management.

impacts.name: Indian Rupee
impacts.why: Strong foreign equity portfolio inflows and unwinding of dollar positions boosted the rupee.

why_moved: Heavy foreign portfolio inflows into Indian stocks and short covering by traders pushed the rupee to its highest exchange rate in seven months.
